//: REAL UR5e plus the real wrist camera. ONE server: 'case 1/run_server.sh' takes the host (192.168.1.100) as its ARGUMENT -- sudo strips env, so the target cannot be a variable -- and pins UR_MODEL=ur5e with reduced speed/accel caps inside the wrapper. UR_VISION=1 mounts case 1/camera's tools, giving 59 tools from one MCP. Paths are RELATIVE to the repo root, so this file works on any clone. macOS only: set command to '/usr/bin/sudo' and prepend '-n' to args. To activate: run the preflight (case 1/preflight_real_robot.py <ip>), copy this over .mcp.json, restart Claude Code. Flip back with mcp.simulator.json.
